description: Pinned base-image digests for the kernel-v1 OCI bake. Every digest MUST be pinned by digest+tag in production; mutable tag builds are blocked at release:verify-placeholder by the multi-arch binary architecture test. The placeholder values below are obvious all-zeros; they are replaced by real digests during a CI run when the base-image promotion step runs (task 50 territory).

agent-runtime.description: Minimal glibc-based runtime image for the kernel-v1 agent. Holds /usr/local/bin/kernel-v1-agent (UID 65532) and exposes port 9464 (Prometheus scrape). Real digest resolution belongs to task 50.
agent-runtime.policy: All base image digests must be pinned by digest + tag in production. Mutable tag builds are blocked at release:verify-placeholder by the multi-arch binary architecture test.
